title: Constantinople falls to the Ottoman Turks
summary: After a siege of nearly two months, the army of Sultan Mehmed II stormed Constantinople. The last Byzantine emperor, Constantine XI, died in the fighting.
reason: The Ottomans had surrounded the shrunken Byzantine state for decades, and Mehmed II used giant cannon to breach its walls.
significance: It ended the Byzantine Empire and made the city the capital of the Ottoman Empire for nearly five centuries.
